text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- President Lennart Meri opened a memorial to the legendary university director Hugo Treffner in Tartu.
- The regular meeting of the Baltic presidents will take place in Otepaa today. The presidents of Ukraine and Poland will arrive Tuesday.
- The commander of the Swedish armed forces, General Owe Wiktorin, will arrive for a visit to Estonia today.
- One-hundred secondary school pupils have decided to spend a week in the Kuperjanov Infantry Battalion in August, but the general staff has not yet selected the army unit to host them.
- The former director of the Silmet chemical and metal processing company has appealed to the labour dispute commission to claim compensation for what he claims was illegal dismissal.
- The defence forces and defence ministry are looking for new training grounds because some of the present ones are located in nature protection zones.
- Russian foreign minister Yevgeni Primakov told the daily that Russia desires good relations with Estonia, but accused Estonia of ignoring OSCE recommendations.

- The economy ministry considers the oil export agreement with the Russian Orenburg region and the building of an oil terminal in Tallinn a useful move for Estonia. The right-wing opposition has attacked the plan.
